name: 95006 · Boulder Creek, CA
findings: ZIP 95006 (Boulder Creek) has 23 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95006 (Boulder Creek) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95006 (Boulder Creek) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
